rules_initial.example_text: The Apple iPhone 15 Pro (model A2848) features a 6.1 inches LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED display. It is powered by the A17 Pro chip with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of internal storage. The device runs on iOS 17, is equipped with a 48MP main camera, and a 3274 mAh battery.
guidelines: The subject should always be the full commercial name of the device.
Normalize capacities to include units (e.g., '8GB', '5000 mAh').
Extract the specific processor model name as the object for 'has_processor'.
If multiple camera resolutions are listed, create separate triples for each, or specify the primary camera.
Screen size should include the unit 'inches'.
Ensure 'has_brand' refers to the manufacturer (e.g., 'Samsung', 'Xiaomi').

rules_final.example_text: The Apple iPhone 15 Pro (model A2848) features a 6.1 inches LTPO Super Retina XDR OLED display. guidelines: The subject should always be the full commercial name of the device.
Normalize capacities and speeds to include units (e.g., '8GB', '5000 mAh', '65W', '165Hz').
Extract the specific processor model name as the object for 'has_processor'.
If multiple camera resolutions are listed, create separate triples for each, or specify the primary camera.
Screen size should include the unit 'inches'.
Ensure 'has_brand' refers to the manufacturer (e.g., 'Samsung', 'Xiaomi').
Use 'has_feature' for unique hardware additions like triggers, special ports, or lighting.
Extract network standards (e.g., '5G', 'LTE', 'GSM') using 'supports_network'.
Extract the device price including the currency symbol or code using 'has_price'.
Extract device weight using 'has_weight' (e.g., '99g').
Extract screen resolution as pixels using 'has_resolution' (e.g., '128x160 pixels').
Use 'supports_expansion' for expandable storage options like 'microSD'.
Use 'has_connectivity' for communication standards like 'Bluetooth' or 'NFC'.
Use 'has_color' to extract available color options; create a separate triple for each color mentioned.
Extract IP ratings (e.g., 'IPX4', 'IP68') using 'has_ip_rating'.
Extract speaker configurations (e.g., 'stereo speakers', 'mono speaker') using 'has_speaker_type'.
Extract biometric security hardware (e.g., 'side-mounted fingerprint sensor', 'face unlock') using 'has_biometric_sensor'.
Use 'has_sensor' to extract specialized hardware sensors such as heart rate monitors, SpO2 sensors, or accelerometers; create a separate triple for each sensor.

Key hardware includes a 50MP dual main camera, an 8MP selfie camera, and a large 5200 mAh battery with 10W wired charging.

The MWg Atom Life is a discontinued Windows Mobile 6 Professional smartphone released in January 2007. It features a 2.7-inch resistive touchscreen, an Intel XScale 624 MHz CPU, 64MB RAM, and 1GB ROM. The device includes a 2MP main camera with LED flash, a VGA selfie camera, and connectivity options such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 1.2, and an infrared port. It is powered by a removable 1530 mAh Li-Po battery.

The itel Smart Watch 2, released in 2023, is a basic black wearable featuring a 1.8-inch IPS LCD display and an IP68 rating for water and dust resistance. It runs on a proprietary OS and includes health sensors for heart rate, SpO2, and acceleration, powered by a 230 mAh battery. The device lacks cellular connectivity, Wi-Fi, and a camera, relying on Bluetooth 5.1 for communication.

The Sony Ericsson WT18i is a discontinued Android-based smartphone released in Q3 2011. It features a compact 3.2-inch TFT display (320x480), a 3.15 MP main camera, and is powered by an 806 MHz Marvell PXA 920 CPU with limited 150MB internal memory. Additional highlights include a Walkman player, a removable 1200 mAh battery, and a lightweight design weighing 110g.

The VK Mobile VK7000, announced in March 2006, was a compact GSM/UMTS phone that was ultimately cancelled. It featured a small 1.8-inch TFT display, a 1.3 MP main camera, a VGA selfie camera for video calls, and a removable 800mAh Li-Ion battery.

Released in October 2018, the Panasonic Eluga X1 Pro is a premium-build smartphone featuring a glass body with a stainless steel frame and a 6.18-inch IPS LCD display (1080 x 2246). It is powered by a Helio P60 chipset running Android 8.1, with memory options of 64GB/4GB RAM or 128GB/6GB RAM. The device includes a 16MP dual main camera, a 16MP selfie camera, and a 3000 mAh battery with wireless charging support. Notable features include an infrared port and Face ID, priced at approximately 350 EUR.

The AT&T Quickfire is a discontinued QWERTY keyboard phone released in November 2008. It features a 2.8-inch TFT display, a 1.3 MP main camera, and 29MB of internal memory expandable via microSD. This GSM/HSPA device lacks Wi-Fi, a selfie camera, and a 3.5mm jack, and is powered by a removable 1200 mAh battery.

Released in October 2021, the Fairphone 4 is a 5G-enabled smartphone featuring a 6.3-inch IPS LCD display and a Snapdragon 750G chipset. It offers memory configurations of 128GB/6GB or 256GB/8GB RAM and a dual 48MP main camera system capable of 4K video. Notably, it is built for durability with IP54 rating and MIL-STD-810G compliance, and features a removable 3905 mAh battery and a standard 5-year warranty.

The Apple iPhone 15 Plus, released in September 2023, features a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with a peak brightness of 2000 nits. It is powered by the A16 Bionic chip with 6GB of RAM and storage options up to 512GB. The device boasts a dual-camera system led by a 48MP wide lens and a 12MP ultrawide lens, supporting 4K video. Other key specs include a 4383 mAh battery with MagSafe wireless charging, IP68 water resistance, and a USB Type-C port. It is available in five colors and starts at approximately $929.99.

The Alcatel 1L Pro (2021) is an entry-level Android 11 (Go edition) smartphone released in June 2021. It features a 6.1-inch IPS LCD display (720x1560), a Unisoc SC9863A octa-core chipset, and basic memory specs with 2GB RAM and 32GB internal storage. The device includes a 13MP dual rear camera, a 5MP selfie camera, and is powered by a 3000 mAh battery. Priced around 110 EUR, it is a budget-friendly device with a plastic build and rear-mounted fingerprint sensor.

Released in February 2018, the verykool s5036 Apollo is an entry-level Android 7.0 smartphone featuring a 5.0-inch IPS LCD display (480x854 pixels). It is powered by a Mediatek MT6580M quad-core processor with 1GB RAM and 8GB internal storage. The device includes a dual rear camera (8MP main and 2MP depth), a 5MP selfie camera, and a removable 2000 mAh battery. Additional features include dual SIM support, a rear-mounted fingerprint sensor, and a microUSB 2.0 port.

The BenQ C36 is a discontinued GSM feature phone released in April 2008. It is a compact, lightweight device weighing 78g, featuring a 2.0-inch TFT display (176 x 220 pixels), a 1.3 MP main camera, and a removable 640 mAh battery. Notable features include dedicated music keys, an FM radio, microSD support, and an MP3 player, though it lacks Bluetooth, WLAN, and a selfie camera.

The Vodafone Smart V8 is a discontinued Android 7.1.1 smartphone released in June 2017. It features a 5.5-inch Full HD IPS LCD display, a Snapdragon 435 octa-core processor, 3GB of RAM, and 32GB of internal storage. For photography, it is equipped with a 16MP main camera and an 8MP selfie camera. The device is powered by a 3000 mAh battery and includes a rear-mounted fingerprint sensor and NFC support.

The Acer Iconia Tab 10 A3-A40 is a discontinued 10.1-inch Android 6.0 tablet released in June 2016. It features a 1920 x 1200 IPS LCD display, a quad-core 1.3 GHz Mediatek MT8163A chipset, 2GB of RAM, and internal storage options ranging from 16GB to 64GB. Key hardware includes a 5MP main camera, a 2MP selfie camera, quad stereo speakers, and a 6100 mAh battery. The device lacks cellular connectivity, relying on dual-band Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.0.

The Maxwest Gravity 5 LTE is a discontinued budget smartphone released in February 2016. It features a 5.0-inch IPS LCD display (720x1280), runs on Android 5.1 (Lollipop) with a Snapdragon 210 quad-core processor, and has minimal memory with 1GB RAM and 8GB internal storage. It is equipped with an 8MP main camera, a 2MP selfie camera, and a removable 2200 mAh battery.

Released in January 2023, the TCL Ion X is an entry-level Android smartphone priced at approximately 100 EUR. It features a 6.0-inch IPS LCD display (720x1440), a Mediatek Helio G25 octa-core processor, 3GB of RAM, and 32GB of internal storage. The device is equipped with a 13MP main camera, a 5MP selfie camera, and a removable 3000 mAh battery with 10W charging.

The Spice Smart Flo 503 (Mi-503) is a discontinued entry-level Android 4.4.2 smartphone released in August 2014. It features a 5.0-inch IPS LCD display (480x854), a dual-core 1.3 GHz CPU, and minimal memory with 512MB RAM and 4GB internal storage. It is equipped with an 8MP main camera, a 2MP selfie camera, and a 2000 mAh battery.

The Sony Ericsson Xperia Arc S is a discontinued Android smartphone released in September 2011. It features a 4.2-inch LED-backlit LCD display, a Qualcomm Snapdragon S2 chipset with a 1.4 GHz CPU, and 512MB of RAM. Key hardware includes an 8MP main camera capable of 720p video, a removable 1500 mAh battery, and a lightweight design at 117g.

Released in November 2023, the Honor 100 is a 5G smartphone featuring a 6.7-inch 120Hz OLED display with a peak brightness of 2600 nits. It is powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 chipset, offering up to 16GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage. The device boasts a 50MP main camera with OIS and a 50MP selfie camera, both capable of 4K video recording. It is equipped with a 5000 mAh battery supporting fast 100W wired charging and is priced at approximately 320 EUR.

The Tecno Pova 5 is a budget-friendly smartphone featuring a large 6.78-inch 120Hz IPS LCD display and a powerful 6000 mAh battery with 45W fast charging. It is powered by a Mediatek Helio G99 chipset with 8GB of RAM and storage options of 128GB or 256GB. Key hardware includes a 50MP main camera, stereo speakers, and Android 13, priced at approximately ₹11,999.

The Sagem my721z is a discontinued GSM feature phone released in February 2008. It features a 2.2-inch TFT display, a 3.15 MP main camera with video recording, and a dedicated microSD slot. This compact silver device supports Bluetooth and FM radio, but lacks WLAN, a selfie camera, and a 3.5mm jack. It is powered by a removable 1000mAh Li-Ion battery providing up to 3 hours of talk time.

The BLU G73, released in June 2023, is an affordable Android 13 smartphone (~140 EUR) featuring a large 6.8-inch 90Hz IPS LCD display. Key specs include 128GB storage, 6GB RAM, and a substantial 5000mAh battery with 18W charging. It is equipped with a 50MP triple rear camera system and an 8MP selfie camera, housed in a build featuring an eco-leather back.

The BlackBerry Keyone, released in April 2017, is a productivity-focused smartphone featuring a signature capacitive touch QWERTY keyboard and a 4.5-inch IPS LCD display. Powered by a Snapdragon 625 chipset on Android 7.1 (upgradable to 8.1), it offers memory options of 32GB/3GB RAM or 64GB/4GB RAM. Key hardware includes a 12MP main camera capable of 4K video, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 3500 mAh battery with 18W fast charging. It is built with an aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass 4, priced at approximately 290 EUR.

Released in June 2021, the Gionee Smartwatch 7 is an entry-level wearable priced around 50 EUR. It features a 1.3-inch TFT LCD display, IP67 water resistance, and health sensors for heart rate, SpO2, and acceleration. The device runs a proprietary OS, connects via Bluetooth 4.0, and is powered by a 130 mAh battery.

The Coolpad Cool 10A is an affordable Android 11 smartphone released in March 2021, priced at approximately 90 EUR. It features a 6.52-inch IPS LCD display (720x1600), a Unisoc SC9863A octa-core chipset, and 64GB of internal storage with 2GB of RAM. It is equipped with a dual rear camera (13MP wide and 0.3MP depth), a 5MP selfie camera, and a 4000 mAh battery with 10W wired charging.

Released in December 2022, the Wiko 5G is a HarmonyOS smartphone featuring a 6.78-inch 120Hz IPS LCD display and a Snapdragon 695 5G chipset. It is equipped with 8GB of RAM and storage options of 128GB or 256GB. Notable hardware includes a high-resolution 108MP quad-camera system, a 16MP selfie camera, and a 4000mAh battery supporting fast 66W wired charging. The device is splash-resistant, supports dual SIMs, and is priced at approximately 270 EUR.

The Philips I908 is a discontinued Dual SIM smartphone released in August 2015. It features a 5.0-inch Full HD IPS LCD display, an octa-core 1.7 GHz processor, 2GB of RAM, and 16GB of internal storage running Android 4.4.2. For photography, it includes a 13MP main camera capable of 1080p video and a 5MP selfie camera, all powered by a 3000 mAh battery.

The HP Elite x3 is a discontinued Windows 10 smartphone released in 2016. It features a 5.96-inch AMOLED display (1440 x 2560), a Snapdragon 820 processor, 4GB RAM, and 64GB storage. Notable hardware includes an IP67 and MIL-STD-810G rated durable body, a 16MP main camera with 4K video, Bang & Olufsen stereo speakers, and a 4150 mAh battery with wireless charging. It also supports Microsoft Continuum and iris scanning.

Released in November 2023, the Infinix Smart 8 is an affordable smartphone (approx. 100 EUR) featuring a 6.6-inch 90Hz IPS LCD display and a Unisoc T606 octa-core processor. It is equipped with 128GB storage, 8GB RAM, and a long-lasting 5000mAh battery with 10W wired charging. For photography, it has a 13MP dual main camera and an 8MP selfie camera, running on Android 13.

The BLU Studio X5 Max, released in July 2022, is an entry-level Android 11 (Go edition) smartphone priced at approximately 50 EUR. It features a 5.7-inch IPS LCD display, a quad-core 1.3 GHz CPU, 2GB of RAM, and 32GB of internal storage. The device includes a 5MP dual rear camera, a 2MP selfie camera, and is powered by a removable 2700 mAh battery.

The Oukitel RT6 is a rugged Android 13 tablet released in July 2023, designed for extreme durability with IP68/IP69K ratings, MIL-STD-810H compliance, and drop resistance. Notable for its massive 20,000 mAh battery with 33W fast charging and reverse wired capabilities, it features a 10.1-inch IPS LCD (1200 x 1920), 256GB storage, 8GB RAM, and a Mediatek MT8788 chipset. It includes 16MP front and rear cameras and is priced at approximately 350 EUR.

The LeEco Le 2 is a discontinued Android 6.0 smartphone released in April 2016. It features a 5.5-inch 1080p IPS LCD display, 3GB of RAM with storage options of 32GB or 64GB, and is powered by either a Helio X20 or Snapdragon 652 chipset. Key specifications include a 16MP main camera capable of 4K video, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 3000 mAh battery with 18W fast charging. Notable features include an infrared port, rear-mounted fingerprint sensor, and USB Type-C connectivity.

The Kyocera Hydro Life is a discontinued, rugged Android 4.3 smartphone released in August 2014. It is designed for extreme durability, featuring IP57 dust/water resistance and MIL-STD-810G compliance. Key specs include a 4.5-inch IPS LCD (540x960), a Snapdragon 200 quad-core processor, 1.5GB RAM, and 8GB of internal storage. It is equipped with a 5MP main camera, a 2MP selfie camera, and a removable 2000 mAh battery.

The Icemobile Prime 5.5 is a discontinued Android 4.4.2 (KitKat) smartphone released in August 2014. It features a 5.46-inch IPS LCD display (720x1280), a quad-core 1.3 GHz Cortex-A7 CPU, 1GB of RAM, and 16GB of internal storage. Key hardware includes an 8MP main camera, a 2MP selfie camera, Dual SIM support, and a removable 2250 mAh battery.

Released in September 2023, the Blackview A96 is an affordable smartphone ($161.69) featuring a 6.5-inch 120Hz IPS LCD display. It is powered by a Mediatek Helio G99 chipset with options for 8GB or 12GB of RAM and 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. The device includes a 48MP dual rear camera system capable of 1440p video, a 16MP selfie camera, and a 4380mAh battery with 18W wired charging. It runs Android 13 and supports NFC and dual SIMs.

The Energizer U680S is an entry-level Android 11 smartphone released in Q3 2021, priced around 120 EUR. Its standout feature is a massive 7000 mAh battery, complementing a large 6.8-inch IPS LCD display. It is powered by a Unisoc SC9863A octa-core chipset with 2GB RAM and 32GB internal storage. The device includes a triple main camera (13MP lead), a 5MP selfie camera, and supports Dual SIM and LTE connectivity.

The Ericsson A2628 is a discontinued GSM phone released in 2001. It features a basic 4-line monochrome display, a NiMH battery providing up to 11 hours of talk time, and minimal connectivity with no camera, Bluetooth, or WLAN. It includes basic utilities like a calculator, alarm, and three built-in games.

The Lava Yuva 2 Pro is an entry-level Android 12 smartphone released in February 2023, priced at ₹6,620. It features a 6.52-inch IPS LCD display, a Mediatek Helio G37 chipset, 4GB of RAM, and 64GB of internal storage. Key hardware includes a triple rear camera setup led by a 13MP main sensor, a 5MP selfie camera, and a large 5000 mAh battery with 10W wired charging.

The Meizu 18s Pro is a 5G smartphone released in September 2021, featuring a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and high 1440 x 3200 resolution. It is powered by the Snapdragon 888+ 5G chipset with up to 12GB RAM and 256GB UFS 3.1 storage. The device boasts a triple main camera system led by a 50MP wide sensor with OIS and 8K video recording, complemented by a 44MP selfie camera. It includes a 4500 mAh battery supporting 40W wired and wireless charging, an ultrasonic under-display fingerprint sensor, and is priced at approximately 610 EUR.

The Spice Smart Flo 508 (Mi-508) is a discontinued budget Android 4.4.2 (KitKat) smartphone released in August 2014. It features a 5.0-inch IPS LCD display (480 x 854 pixels), a dual-core 1.3 GHz CPU, and limited memory with 512MB RAM and 4GB internal storage. For photography, it has an 8MP main camera and a 2MP selfie camera. The device is powered by a 2000 mAh Li-Ion battery and supports dual SIM (GSM) connectivity.

The VK Mobile VK300 is a discontinued GSM mobile phone released in July 2005. It is a compact, 75g device featuring a 1.8-inch TFT display and a secondary external STN screen. This basic model lacks a camera, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and a card slot, supporting only 2G networks and WAP 1.2.1 browsing. It is powered by a removable 720 mAh Li-Ion battery providing up to 3 hours of talk time.
